work.originalTitle: 맥스큐 디지털화보집 Secret B Vol.15 양유나
work.summary: Digital MAXQ Secret B photobook featuring Korean fitness model, trainer, and influencer Yang Yuna (양유나). MAXQ's 2024-05-28 publisher article identifies her as the Vol. 15 solo model and announces an e-book/app release for 2024-05-31. Aladin's Secret B e-book series record lists the Vol. 15 title as a PDF from 2024-06. Page count and ISBN were not verified. No cover image or paid PDF was copied because reuse permission is unconfirmed.

edition.contentSummary: MAXQ's 2024-05-28 article announces Secret B No. 15 starring Yang Yuna for release on 2024-05-31 through e-book sites and apps. Aladin's Secret B e-book series record lists the exact Vol. 15 title as a MAXQ International PDF dated 2024-06; its retailer month differs from the publisher's announced release day. The page count and ISBN were not verified. Bibliographic metadata only; no paid file or cover is copied or mirrored.
